scope: Three-run-per-cell fresh-state v4/v3/v4 short-prefill control; completed full-matrix results remain unchanged.
findings: The 10–17% short retained-prefill loss in the accumulated-history matrix does not reproduce on these fresh deployments.
Retained +1K/+2K v4 medians range from +0.1% to +3.4% versus the intervening v3 control; +8K is approximately 1% lower.
A matched accumulated-decode-history control is still required to determine whether serving history affects the versions differently.
